friction_events.description: Representative browser navigation to the deployed GitHub Pages candidate was administratively blocked before DOM, console, or network verification could run.

decision_trace.decision: Stop the resident chain at the explicit administrative browser boundary.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Chromium returned net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR on the first candidate navigation; the human launch envelope forbids retry or bypass of explicit security/connector denials.
decision_trace.action: No retry, alternate browser, alternate route, product edit, RETURN, or E8 claim was attempted.
decision_trace.outcome: Owned verification remains incomplete and the worker closes with zero productive units under TRANSPORT_BOUNDARY.

top_time_sinks.note: Browser smoke could not begin because navigation was blocked administratively.

unfinished_debt.item: The browser smoke for portfolio-tts-generic-text-surface-browser-smoke-v1 remains incomplete; no product regression was proven or repaired.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Make the browser-network capability preflight distinguish an administratively blocked GitHub Pages route from an unknown capability before a verification PIN is selected.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Avoid consuming an exclusive browser-verification claim when the runtime cannot navigate to the required deployed surface.

exit_audit_v1.public_safe_summary: Fresh v3.30 worker won the TTS browser-smoke PIN and persisted STARTED. Its first Chromium navigation to the deployed candidate was blocked by administrator policy. Per the launch boundary rule it did not retry or bypass the denial, made no product edit, completed no productive unit, and closed with a durable TRANSPORT_BOUNDARY.
